titleEn: Maximum Number of Darts Inside of a Circular Dartboard
title: 圆形靶内的最大飞镖数量
summary: 移动半径为 r 的圆形飞镖靶，求最多能同时覆盖多少给定点，边界也算覆盖。
insight: 最优圆若覆盖至少两点，可平移到使两点位于边界。枚举距离不超过 2r 的点对，计算经过两点的两个半径 r 圆心并计数。
pitfalls: 点对对应两个可能圆心
浮点比较需要误差容忍

solutions.title: 点对确定候选圆心
solutions.idea: 枚举所有由两点边界约束产生的圆并统计覆盖点。
steps: mid 为中点，沿垂直单位向量偏移 sqrt(r²-d²/4) 得两个圆心
对每个圆心统计平方距离<=r²+epsilon 的点数并更新

code.java: class Solution { private int count(int[][] darts,double x,double y,int r){int answer=0;for(int[] point:darts){double dx=point[0]-x,dy=point[1]-y;if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=r*(double)r+1e-7)answer++;}return answer;}public int numPoints(int[][] darts,int r){int answer=1;for(int i=0;i<darts.length;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<darts.length;j++){double dx=darts[j][0]-darts[i][0],dy=darts[j][1]-darts[i][1],distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(distance==0||distance>2.0*r+1e-9)continue;double middleX=(darts[i][0]+darts[j][0])/2.0,middleY=(darts[i][1]+darts[j][1])/2.0,height=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,r*(double)r-distance*distance/4));double offsetX=-dy/distance*height,offsetY=dx/distance*height;answer=Math.max(answer,count(darts,middleX+offsetX,middleY+offsetY,r));answer=Math.max(answer,count(darts,middleX-offsetX,middleY-offsetY,r));}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun count(darts:Array<IntArray>,x:Double,y:Double,r:Int):Int=darts.count{val dx=it[0]-x;val dy=it[1]-y;dx*dx+dy*dy<=r.toDouble()*r+1e-7};fun numPoints(darts:Array<IntArray>,r:Int):Int{var answer=1;for(i in darts.indices)for(j in i+1 until darts.size){val dx=(darts[j][0]-darts[i][0]).toDouble();val dy=(darts[j][1]-darts[i][1]).toDouble();val distance=kotlin.math.hypot(dx,dy);if(distance==0.0||distance>2.0*r+1e-9)continue;val middleX=(darts[i][0]+darts[j][0])/2.0;val middleY=(darts[i][1]+darts[j][1])/2.0;val height=kotlin.math.sqrt(maxOf(0.0,r.toDouble()*r-distance*distance/4));val offsetX=-dy/distance*height;val offsetY=dx/distance*height;answer=maxOf(answer,count(darts,middleX+offsetX,middleY+offsetY,r),count(darts,middleX-offsetX,middleY-offsetY,r))};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int covered(vector<vector<int>>& darts,double x,double y,int r){int answer=0;for(auto& point:darts){double dx=point[0]-x,dy=point[1]-y;answer+=dx*dx+dy*dy<=r*(double)r+1e-7;}return answer;}public:int numPoints(vector<vector<int>>& darts,int r){int answer=1;for(int i=0;i<(int)darts.size();++i)for(int j=i+1;j<(int)darts.size();++j){double dx=darts[j][0]-darts[i][0],dy=darts[j][1]-darts[i][1],distance=hypot(dx,dy);if(distance==0||distance>2.0*r+1e-9)continue;double middleX=(darts[i][0]+darts[j][0])/2.0,middleY=(darts[i][1]+darts[j][1])/2.0,height=sqrt(max(0.0,r*(double)r-distance*distance/4));double offsetX=-dy/distance*height,offsetY=dx/distance*height;answer=max({answer,covered(darts,middleX+offsetX,middleY+offsetY,r),covered(darts,middleX-offsetX,middleY-offsetY,r)});}return answer;} };
